manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the highest point of a toss, the vertical velocity passes through zero while gravity accelerates the ball downward at -g without pause.
manifest.description: Two panels compare a vertical toss and its velocity-time graph. On the left, the ball moves along a height ruler with vectors for velocity, acceleration and gravity. On the right, the velocity line has slope -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
